resources.string: Select your original home to stop using Alkhamis Launcher as Home, or Alkhamis Launcher to switch back. The original launcher must be enabled and your TV must provide a home picker; use the restore script first if it was disabled.
The TV home apps were turned back on.
No ads, the shrine home screen

Home did not change. It still opens %1$s.

The safe way is Home button, the first button below. Turn it on in Accessibility. It does not turn any app off. Uninstalling this launcher puts the remote's Home button back.

Or turn on Developer options, then Network debugging or Wireless debugging, and try again. On Android 11 and newer the TV may ask for a pairing code. A Default apps, Home row is often missing on Google TV.
When the TV home opens, Alkhamis Launcher comes forward. It does not turn any app off.

1. Open accessibility settings.
2. Choose Home button.
3. Turn it on, and allow it if the TV asks.
4. Press Home on the remote. Alkhamis Launcher opens.
5. Turn off here stops it. Nothing else is switched off.
Turn Home button off in Accessibility settings.
Accessibility settings did not open. Look for Accessibility in the TV settings.
Set Free My TV to Original first.
The previous home app was left on because it saved the Wi-Fi. Turning that app off would delete those networks. The Home setting itself does not.
The dock row holds this many apps. The rest move to the rows below.
Adds a lifted tile, icon zoom and smooth colour transitions. May increase memory use; the actual difference depends on your TV.
Uses the current theme or built-in layout and motion settings. Pushing or resetting a theme also clears your on-TV choices.
Opens the input switcher when the remote\'s Input button is pressed.
Makes the remote\'s Home button open this launcher.
%1$s can show a card on your home screen. Keeping it hidden leaves the app\'s normal tile as it is.
The card is named \'%1$s\'. The app is \'%2$s\'.
%1$s was updated with a different signing key, so your earlier answer no longer applies. Decide again for its card.
%1$s changed the name of its card since you decided. Decide again for it.
The launcher asks once and remembers your answer.
Choose the dock place to change and press OK. Back to finish.
Now choose the app to put there and press OK. Back to choose another place.
Choose the dock place for this app and press OK. Back to cancel.
OK picks up an app, arrows move it, Back places it. Back again to finish.
Press to add to Home · Hold for options
Press to open · Hold for options
Left and right reorder an app. OK hides it, uninstalls it, or deletes a built-in app.
OK adds the app at the end of the featured row.
Nothing is pinned. Add an app, or the first row fills with whatever is installed.
Every launchable app is already in the dock or hidden.
The shrine dock is back. Your other choices were kept.
OK puts the app back on Home. Hiding never uninstalls it.
Hidden. It is listed under Hidden apps.

This removes %1$s for the current user, the same as pm uninstall --user 0. It stays gone until you restore it from Restore deleted apps. The Play Store does not put a preinstalled app back by itself. Hide and App info still work if you leave this screen.
This app is part of the TV and cannot be deleted: settings, the system UI, Play services, the Play Store, or this launcher. You can still hide other apps.
Built in. The system Uninstall dialog cannot remove it. Delete completely needs Network debugging. Hide, or open App info to disable it.
Deleted for this user. Restore it from Restore deleted apps.
OK puts back an app this launcher removed. Debugging on this TV has to be connected.
This launcher has not deleted any apps.
Restoring an app uses this TV\'s own debugging service. Nothing is sent to another device.

Network debugging: Settings, Device preferences, About, press OK on Build seven times, then Developer options, Network debugging. Press Connect. If the TV shows an Allow debugging prompt, allow it and press Connect again. The connection stays on this TV. Wireless pairing is not built in, so the launcher does not carry a TLS library.
Connecting to debugging on this TV…

Settings, Device preferences, About, press OK on Build seven times. Developer options, then Network debugging.\nالإعدادات، تفضيلات الجهاز، حول، اضغط موافق على رقم الإصدار سبع مرات. خيارات المطوّر، ثم تصحيح الشبكة.
Nothing is sent off this TV. Wireless pairing is not included.
Allow the debugging prompt on the TV, then come back.
That is not the stock launcher.
This TV still needs the secure-settings permission.
A system popup will appear: tick Always allow, then Allow.\nستظهر نافذة من النظام: فعّل «السماح دائمًا»، ثم اضغط سماح.
The TV has not allowed this launcher yet. Tick Always allow, then Allow. That prompt should not return.\nلم يسمح التلفاز بعد. فعّل «السماح دائمًا»، ثم اضغط سماح. لا يُفترض أن تعود النافذة.
Waiting for Allow. Another connection is not started while that popup is open.\nبانتظار السماح. لا يبدأ اتصال آخر ما دامت النافذة مفتوحة.
Nothing is listening on this TV. Turn on Network debugging, then test again.\nلا شيء يستمع على هذا التلفاز. فعّل تصحيح الشبكة ثم أعد الاختبار.
Connected. Next, turn off the stock launcher.\nتم الاتصال. التالي: أوقف الشاشة الأصلية.
This TV uses Network debugging on port 5555. No pairing code.\nهذا التلفاز يستخدم تصحيح الشبكة على المنفذ ٥٥٥٥. لا رمز اقتران.
The TV refused that. Its reply is below.\nرفض التلفاز. الرد في الأسفل.
Disabled for this user.\nعُطّل لهذا المستخدم.
Installed version %1$s. Newer builds are listed from the shrine releases. An older build will not replace this one until you uninstall it.
Could not reach the release list. Check the network and open this screen again.
Allow this launcher to install apps, then try again.
A downgrade needs an uninstall first. Android will not install an older version over this one. Uninstalling removes this launcher and the file it downloaded.
Downloaded. It is not installed: this copy is older, so uninstall the launcher first. Uninstalling also deletes that download.
The launcher changes straight away. Arabic uses Western digits (0–9) unless you choose Arabic-Indic (٠–٩).
OK turns a shortcut on or off. Left and right move it. Settings stays on the bar.
None of these shortcuts open on this TV.
No pictures were found in those folders.
That picture could not be used.
Back to the shrine picture, dim 45%.
The index address must start with https.
No extra themes in the catalog yet.
OK applies the theme. Preview opens the real Home first.
Scan the code on a phone, enter the PIN, then upload a file. After this app is reinstalled, older files can stay in that folder without showing here.
Allow storage so files can be saved in Downloads.
Allow this launcher to install apps, then try again
This preview appears after the theme is downloaded.
The theme could not be applied.
Settings stays on the bar. You can still move it.
The shrine dream can show a clock or a slideshow every 5 seconds. Applying the timers needs debugging on this TV if the system does not allow it.
Prayer times is built into this launcher. Other widgets ask the TV for permission.
No widgets on the home screen.
Added. It is on the home screen.\nأُضيفت. هي على الشاشة الرئيسية.
Prayer times for Dammam, Jafari, is on the home screen.\nمواقيت الصلاة للدمام، الجعفري، على الشاشة الرئيسية.
Prayer times is already on the home screen.\nمواقيت الصلاة موجودة على الشاشة.
Allow this launcher to add the widget, then come back.\nاسمح لهذه الشاشة بإضافة الويدجت ثم عُد.
The TV did not allow that widget.\nلم يسمح التلفاز بهذا الويدجت.
This TV has no screen for allowing a widget.\nلا توجد شاشة إذن للويدجت على هذا التلفاز.
Setup was cancelled, so the widget was not added.\nأُلغي الإعداد، فلم يُضف الويدجت.
The widget’s setup screen did not open.\nلم تُفتح شاشة إعداد الويدجت.
That widget could not be added.\nتعذّرت إضافة الويدجت.
Remove this widget from the home screen?\nإزالة هذا الويدجت من الشاشة الرئيسية؟
Jafari is the default. Times come from Aladhan for the place you pick.
The times could not be loaded.
This changes the launcher clock, prayer times, widgets and the screensaver. The TV’s own clock changes only if you set the system time zone.
Set this zone on the TV
The TV’s time zone was updated.
The TV did not allow a time-zone change. Debugging can try, or open Date settings.
That time zone cannot be used.
Choose this launcher as Home. If the system will not, the Home button can still open it.
This launcher is the default Home.
Home button opens Alkhamis Launcher (via Home button service).
This launcher is not the default Home, and the Home button service is off.
This launcher is not the default Home.
The TV took the default home back.

This TV’s system does not allow choosing another home app.
نظام هذا التلفاز لا يسمح باختيار شاشة رئيسية أخرى.

Home opens Alkhamis Launcher through the Home button service: %1$s.
زر الرئيسية يفتح Alkhamis Launcher عبر خدمة زر الرئيسية: %1$s.
Home opens Alkhamis Launcher.\nالرئيسية تفتح Alkhamis Launcher.
Home still opens %1$s.\nالرئيسية ما زالت تفتح %1$s.

1. If Free My TV is the home screen, set it to Original. That turns the Google launcher back on. Or turn Free My TV off here.\n2. Then turn off the stock launcher here. Home is checked again after that.
Turn Free My TV back on

Turn off Free My TV? It will stop answering Home.
إيقاف Free My TV؟ سيتوقف عن الرد على الرئيسية.

Original, inside Free My TV, turns the Google launcher back on. Do that first if you still want the app installed, then use step 2.
«الأصلي» داخل Free My TV يعيد تشغيل شاشة غوغل. افعله أولًا إن أردت إبقاء التطبيق، ثم الخطوة ٢.
Free My TV still answers Home. Set it to Original, or turn it off, then turn off the stock launcher.\nFree My TV ما زال يرد على الرئيسية. اجعله على «الأصلي»، أو أوقفه، ثم أوقف الشاشة الأصلية.
Turn the stock launcher back on

Turn off the Google TV launcher, the Android TV launcher, and Google Assistant on this TV? Setup is included only when it answers Home. Nothing is uninstalled.\nإيقاف شاشة Google TV وشاشة Android TV ومساعد غوغل على هذا التلفاز؟ يُوقف الإعداد فقط إذا كان يرد على الرئيسية. لا يُحذف شيء.
While the stock launcher is off, recommendations and the Google account home rows stay hidden.
Turn the stock launcher, Assistant, and setup back on?\nإعادة تشغيل الشاشة الأصلية والمساعد والإعداد؟
A package that saved the Wi-Fi would lose those networks, so nothing was changed.\nحزمة حفظت شبكة الواي فاي، وإيقافها يمسح الشبكات، فلم يتغيّر شيء.
Turning the stock launcher back on…
The TV turned %1$s back on. Turn it off again?\nأعاد التلفاز تشغيل %1$s. إيقافه مرة أخرى؟
Turn off %1$s? It answers Home.\nإيقاف %1$s؟ إنه يرد على الرئيسية.
